'''Ryan Driscoll''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Massachusetts State Championship]] on 14 April 2001, according to Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2097">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-ma-states-5th-placed2097/ ma-states-5th-place], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-ma-states-5th-placed2097/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
